get.description:
Return a list of activities performed for a workflow instance.

Identify the instance with `workflow_instance_id`, or with both `filters[workflowed_object_type]` and `filters[workflowed_object_id]` (the same object addressing used by Legacy Workflow Permanent Logs and Workflow Setup). When `workflow_instance_id` is present it is used and the object filters are ignored. Change-order object types also require `project_id`.

parameters.name: workflow_instance_id
parameters.description: Workflow Instance ID. Required unless both `filters[workflowed_object_type]` and `filters[workflowed_object_id]` are provided.

parameters.name: filters[workflowed_object_type]
parameters.description: Tool or V1 class name of the workflowed object. Used with `filters[workflowed_object_id]` to locate the instance when `workflow_instance_id` is omitted.

parameters.name: filters[workflowed_object_id]
parameters.description: ID of the workflowed object. Used with `filters[workflowed_object_type]` to locate the instance when `workflow_instance_id` is omitted.

parameters.name: project_id
parameters.description: Project ID. Required when locating the instance with a change-order `filters[workflowed_object_type]` and no `workflow_instance_id`.

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: Sort attribute. Prefix with `-` for descending order. Omit to keep the default ascending primary-key order. Use `sort=-created_at` for newest-first pagination (for example, panel "Show more" loads of older history).

Per-Page.description: Number of items retrieved per page

Total.description: Total number of items to be retrieved

Link.description: Link headers for the first, prev, next, and last link

file_attachments.description: List of file attachments with their identifying metadata

assigned_to_id.description: Login Information ID of the user the activity is assigned to.

assigned_to_name.description: Full Name of Contact for the assigned Login Information

bic_duration.description: Ball In Court duration in days

performed_by_id.description: Login Information ID of a Workflow User Role Login Information.

performed_by_name.description: Full Name of Contact for Workflow User Role Login Information

reason.description: A human-readable code providing additional detail on the cause of the error.

conn.request("GET", "/rest/v1.0/workflow_activity_histories?workflow_instance_id=SOME_INTEGER_VALUE&filters%5Bworkflowed_object_type%5D=SOME_STRING_VALUE&filters%5Bworkflowed_object_id%5D=SOME_INTEGER_VALUE&project_id=SOME_INTEGER_VALUE&company_id=SOME_INTEGER_VALUE&page=SOME_INTEGER_VALUE&per_page=SOME_INTEGER_VALUE&sort=SOME_STRING_VALUE")

res = conn.getresponse()
data = res.read()

print(data.decode("utf-8"))

x-changelog.summary: Optional sort for workflow activity histories index
x-changelog.description:
List accepts an optional `sort` query parameter. Supported values are
`created_at` and `-created_at`. When omitted, ordering is unchanged
(ascending primary key via pagination defaults). Use `sort=-created_at`
for newest-first pages when loading history incrementally.

x-changelog.summary: Locate activity histories by workflowed object on index and show
x-changelog.description:
List and show now accept `filters[workflowed_object_type]` and
`filters[workflowed_object_id]` as an alternative to `workflow_instance_id`.
Existing callers that pass `workflow_instance_id` are unchanged; when that
parameter is present it takes precedence. Change-order object types also
require `project_id`. Create still requires `workflow_instance_id`.

x-changelog.summary: Added file_attachments to workflow activity histories
x-changelog.description:
Added a `file_attachments` field to the workflow activity history response.
Each entry describes an attached file with its `id`, `name`, and `url`.

x-changelog.summary: Added assigned_to_id and assigned_to_name to workflow activity histories
x-changelog.description:
Added two fields to the workflow activity history response:
- `assigned_to_id`: Login Information ID of the user the activity is assigned to.
- `assigned_to_name`: Full name of the contact for the assigned Login Information.

import http.client

conn = http.client.HTTPSConnection("api.procore.com")

payload = "{\"workflow_activity_history\":{\"workflow_activity_id\":12345,\"workflow_instance_id\":12345,\"workflow_user_role_id\":12345,\"performed_by_id\":12345,\"comments\":\"Forwarding this for review\",\"prostore_file_ids\":[12334],\"attachments\":[\"string\"]}}"

headers = { 'content-type': "application/json" }

conn.request("POST", "/rest/v1.0/workflow_activity_histories?workflow_instance_id=SOME_INTEGER_VALUE&company_id=SOME_INTEGER_VALUE", payload, headers)

res = conn.getresponse()
data = res.read()

print(data.decode("utf-8"))

x-changelog.summary: Attachments sent as prostore_file_ids are now saved
x-changelog.description:
`prostore_file_ids` sent in the `workflow_activity_history` payload were
silently discarded, so the created activity history had no attachments.
They are now accepted and persisted.
